name: 4C-PVP
summary: 4-Chloro-α-pyrrolidinovalerophenone is an emerging recreational designer drug of the pyrrolidinophenone class, similar in structure to α-pyrrolidinopentiophenone (α-PVP). The pharmacology and toxicity of this compound is unknown, though it is presumed to be a stimulant drug.

uses.text: 4-Chloro-α-pyrrolidinovalerophenone (also known as 4-chloro-α-pyrrolidinopentiophenone, 4-chloro-α-PVP, 4Cl-PVP, or 4C-PVP) is an emerging recreational designer drug of the pyrrolidinophenone class, similar in structure to α-pyrrolidinopentiophenone (α-PVP).
